reasons: The rule's preferred position is the absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer; the document contains no solicitation, no-poach or no-hire covenant, so 'compliant' is the correct classification.
The cited paragraph (p0066) is an independent-contractor/no-agency clause and imposes no hiring or solicitation restriction, consistent with the rationale.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed; the original text is left unchanged.
The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure and do not undercut the conclusion.
The rationale usefully records the fallback stance to hold if the Vendor later introduces a non-solicit, which is appropriate internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
